title: What is OOP
description: Understand Object-Oriented Programming and its advantages.

data.text: **Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)** is a programming paradigm based on the concept of objects that contain data and code. It helps organize code in a way that models real-world entities.

items: Encapsulation – Bundle data and methods together
Inheritance – Create new classes from existing ones

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: OOP helps create modular, reusable, and maintainable code.
